title: T.C.S. SWITCH & RELAY
summary: Transmission Controlled Spark (TCS, emissions vacuum-advance control) switch and relay. The TCS switch [2] screws into a threaded boss on the side of the transmission with gasket [5] (View B) and the engine harness lead plugs onto it; the harness leads are held by special clip [4] under a bolt and lock washer. The TCS relay [1] is held to a body panel by one screw [3], located by dimples in the panel (View A), with the engine harness leads plugged into it.

parts.name: SWITCH ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Switch assembly – TCS (transmission controlled spark), in transmission

fastening.to: threaded boss on the side of the transmission case (TRANS ASM.)
fastening.note: View B: switch [2] has its own threaded body and screws directly into the transmission with gasket [5] under its hex; no separate fastener. Engine wiring harness connector pushes onto the switch terminal.

fastening.to: body panel (View A); dimples in the panel locate the relay
fastening.note: View A: screw [3] goes through the relay's mounting tab. Engine harness leads plug onto the relay terminals.
Clip [4] holds the switch wiring leads; it is fastened by a bolt and lock washer (no part number; revision 2 'BOLT & L.WASHER ADDED').

notes_internal: Item 1: hole punch over last digit; 5th/6th digits read 5 and 7 but blotted.
Items 2-5: one or more digits are ink blobs at 900 dpi; marked '?'. Item 3 reads 9422 + three blotted digits.
Screw [3] carries torque triangle 2, but legend triangles 2-5 have no values printed.
Relay mounting panel not named on the page (looks like a body/dash panel near the transmission tunnel).
'K204' stamp at right. Circled 1 next to item 4, circled 3 next to item 5, circled 5 at View A, circled 4 near View B arrow.
